failure_signature: Association or before–after change becomes causation.
control: Use ROUTE_SELECTOR_MIN or FULL and name the unit, evidence and prohibited inference.

failure_signature: Access, permission, evidence, time or evaluation burden remains assumed rather than tested.
control: Run the smallest safe feasibility sprint and record continue, narrow, pivot or stop.

failure_signature: A statistically favourable association or before–after difference is treated as causal or representative without design support.
control: Verify constructs, measures, sampling frame, design logic, uncertainty methods, missingness treatment and validity threats.

failure_signature: Causal, prevalence and generalisation claims require design-specific support.
control: Instrument pilot, scoring rehearsal, missingness check or mock analysis.; preserve work-unit provenance and deviations.

failure_signature: Threshold crossing becomes importance, causality or generalisability
control: Alternative specification, missing-data analysis, negative control or design diagnostic; retain counter-evidence and rejected stronger wording.

failure_signature: The thesis, evidence package, demonstration, slides or oral account describes a different route, release, result or claim.
control: Show the frozen analysis table, one robustness check and the discrepancy between confidence and unresolved-error outcomes. Preserve a same-release fallback and rehearse the hostile question.
